submission.justification: K1 has the best resolution (2.9%) but its intrinsic background (2.0 counts/kg/day) is 4x the 0.5 counts/kg/day budget, and it comes from internal contamination that shielding can't remove. K3 has the best resolution among the crystals that fit the budget (4.5%, 0.30 counts/kg/day). K2 is cleaner but its resolution is 8.5%. Resolution depends only weakly on thickness between 3 and 8 cm, so I chose 5 cm, the thickness that was simulated. I did not run a thickness scan.

requirements.evidence: K3 gives 4.5% FWHM at 5 cm, the best of the crystals within the background budget. K1 is better at 2.9% but fails the low-background constraint.
K3 intrinsic background is 0.30±0.05 counts/kg/day, under the 0.5 budget. K1 is 2.0 and fails.
Crystal-K3 is one of the three listed candidates.
